initial.mass_compensation_scope: continuum enclosed map; particle discretization measured separately
initial.interpretation: Prescribed compensated sphere; not observed or random-spectrum initial conditions

metadata.integrator: KDK with state-dependent predeclared step bounds; no strict symplectic/time-reversal claim
metadata.radius_estimator: median(r/q), fixed original labels .25qL<=q<=.75qL; density proxy, not uniform-density proof
metadata.profile_units: r and q in box units; density ratios to mean; 128^2 full-box z projection
metadata.audit_scope: saved trajectories, diagnostics and shell/projected aggregates; no final particle archive
metadata.clock_scope: one clock pair only; no convergence claim for tiny paired PM response

event200.estimator: first fixed-label median(r/q)^(-3)=200, temporary partial KDK root

turnaround.estimator: linear interpolation of physical radial expansion ratio in ln(a)

initial_force_diagnostic.definition: g=-grad(psi), laplacian(psi)=delta; radial_g=g dot (x-center)/|x-center|, negative means inward; box units
initial_force_diagnostic.reference: continuum compensated spherical core g_exact=-(delta_i/3)*(x-center); fixed core labels only
initial_force_diagnostic.scope: physical particle/force-grid discretization diagnostic, not an FFT implementation check
